mechanisms.name: Collection hero title
mechanisms.evidence: mistral-atom-text-hero-title (data-autoplay, data-grow, data-randomness) + SplitText chunk; the h1 is sr-only and the visible copy is aria-hidden

mechanisms.name: Featured slider
mechanisms.evidence: mistral-block-slider-cards-collection + slider-cards-collection.*.js (Swiper): the six featured stories are one draggable track

mechanisms.name: Post grid
mechanisms.evidence: mistral-section-posts with data-filtering="false" data-load-more="false" data-post-per-page="-1": all 42 cards are server-rendered, the runtime adds no controls

mechanisms.name: Card hover
mechanisms.evidence: .js-slider-item:hover { opacity: .9 } (300ms transition); the image fades in on load via onload
